question: What supreme attainment makes one dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are paired attainments
Great accomplishment is the stated result
Such accomplishment brings favor with the yoginīs
inference: One who attains great accomplishment in enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs
plain_english: One may attain the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation and become dear to the yoginīs.
